Context: 4. Increments

Accrual of next increment on 1st July/ 1st January in respect of employees getting promotion on 1st January/ 1st July, provided 6 months' qualifying service is strictly fulfilled is also allowed to employees who have exercised the option for pay fixation under FR 22 (I) (a) (1) when promoted on regular basis I granted financial upgradation on any date other than the date of his/her annual increment in lower grade.
